text:
deploybot: RELEASE PAUSED: preflight detected secret name canonicalization mismatch. staging contains `inference-api-token` while prod expects `inference_api_token`. failing rule: secret-name-normalization.
nina: ack. underscore vs dash again. this causes our secret-fetcher to not find the key.
owen: this likely came from a terraform module older variant that used dashes. someone must have copied staging env from a sandbox.
remy: what's the impact? if the secret is missing in prod after rollout, service will 503 on startup.
kate: do we have that secret in prod? ops-bot?
ops-bot: checked prod secrets: `default:inference_api_token` exists. no `inference-api-token` in prod. staging has `inference-api-token`.
nina: proposed fix: rename staging secret to `inference_api_token` and add an import shim for 24h bridging both names for backward compatibility in test infra.
owen: renaming in staging is safe. we should also scan any pipelines for references to the old hyphenated name.
remy: and add a linter rule to forbid hyphens in secret names.
deploybot: release remains paused. provide PR link to resume.
kate: plan: nina does secret rename + pipeline grep; remy will add linter; owen will run deploycheck after merge.
nina: creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1322. includes rename, migration job, and test.
ops-bot: scheduled a check for jobs that write secrets with hyphen names across all namespaces. initial scan found 1 job in `devtools` writing `inference-api-token` in dev account.
owen: yep that's the dev sandbox origin. can ignore for prod but we'll add a doc note.
remy: adding CI test to fail on hyphen in secret names.
kate: after merge, we should pin image for 30m and watch startup metrics. also include a release note: "fix: secret name canonicalization in staging to match prod; paused release".
nina: merging after approvals.
deploybot: noted. release will stay paused until `deploycheck` passes.
